description: A big THANK YOU to the people and organizations who have made the last few days so special!Thank you to the NAACP and UAW of Maury County, with a special shoutout to Maury County NAACP President Tamera Sangster. Tamera was incredibly kind and welcoming, and I truly appreciated the opportunity to connect!Thank you also to Cassandra Geeter for having me on her podcast, “Chasing Prudence.” It’s wonderful to see people working to inform, educate, and engage our young people!
